title: [You know how the daily...
content_text:
[You know how the daily dialogue replay already generates audio? I want to add one more step: translate the replay text into Cantonese, and generate a separate Cantonese audio on top of that.]
你知唔知日日嗰个对话重放本来就会出音频？我想加多一步：将个重放文本翻译做粤文，喺原本之上再另外出埋粤语音频。
[Run it with today's material to make sure it works.]
拎今日啲素材行一次，睇下掂唔掂。
[The TTS API supports wrapping the original text in square brackets for a bilingual side-by-side view. The bracketed text doesn't get turned into audio — take a look, and then apply it going forward.]
嗰个 TTS API 支援用方括号包住原文，做双语对照。包住嗰啲字唔会变做音频——你睇下，跟住之后用得。
[What I expect from this feature is one audio file per record — not everything mixed together. See if you can fix that, and verify it.]
我期望呢个功能係一条记录净係出一个音频，唔係全部捞埋一齐。你睇下改唔改到，改完验证一次。
[Got it — so it was a wrong parameter on my end.]
明白——即係我嗰边传错咗个参数。
